subject: Month-end ledger look-up
message: Hi team, Jun Okafor (Finance Operations) filing IT-021 today, 2026-10-22. Could you set me up with view-only entry to the Ledger staging environment? I need it Monday 2026-11-09 through Friday 2026-11-13 (both days included) to compare sample month-end postings against the close checklist. Elena Park is the person I report to. Nothing will be edited, I only want to read the postings and note any that look odd for the close meeting.
